error.description: Underlying document open error, including its native domain and code

reason.description: Standalone file open failure classification supplied by the document workflow

document.description: Internal document UUID for the failed save operation

revision.description: Native document lifecycle revision associated with this save attempt

stage.description: Save workflow stage that failed, e.g. post-write

error.description: Underlying save error, including its native domain and code

stage.description: FSEvents setup step that failed, e.g. create or start

events.message: Unsaved draft restored into its document

conflict.description: Whether the file changed on disk since the draft was written, so the draft opens as a conflict against the disk version

document.description: Internal document UUID whose browser and native snapshots are being synchronized

revision.description: Native document revision captured when the freeze was requested

status.description: Freeze comparison result, e.g. matched or mismatch; absent before completion

snapshot_revision.description: Revision attached to the frozen snapshot; absent when no snapshot was returned

browser_revision.description: Browser-reported native revision at freeze completion

model_version.description: Monaco model version reported by the frozen browser snapshot

barrier_drained.description: Whether the browser edit barrier drained before returning the frozen snapshot

pending_edits.description: Number of browser edits pending when the freeze result was produced

input_passes.description: Number of browser input passes observed by the freeze barrier

snapshot_utf16_length.description: UTF-16 code units in the returned snapshot; absent when no snapshot was returned

native_utf16_length.description: UTF-16 code units in the native document at the freeze observation

native_revision.description: Current native document revision at freeze completion, comparable with browser and snapshot revisions.
